gloss: to reveal, to expose; to dismantle

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: ばらしていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to reveal, to expose, to spill (a secret)
definitions.explanation: To disclose information that was supposed to be kept secret, often carelessly or deliberately.
To break something down into its component parts; to disassemble a machine or structure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ばらさないで⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
⟦サプライズ→サプライズ：10936_sapuraizu⟧⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ばらされた。
examples.english: A friend spilled the plans for the surprise party.

examples.japanese: ⟦{嘘|うそ}→嘘：01796_uso⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ばれる→ばれる：06721_bareru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{怖|こわ}くて→怖い：00864_kowai⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ばらしてしまった。
examples.english: I was afraid of being found out, so I confessed everything myself.

examples.japanese: ⟦エンジン→エンジン：03835_enjin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ばらして⟦{点検|てんけん}→点検：09765_tenken⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I dismantled the engine and inspected it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ばらして⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{出|だ}した→取り出す：04220_toridasu⟧。
examples.english: I took apart an old computer and removed the parts.
I'm good at taking machines apart, but bad at putting them back together.

notes:
Godan verb (す-column): ばらさない / ばらします / ばらす / ばらせば / ばらそう

USAGE:
Both senses are informal/casual. Sense 1 (revealing secrets) is the more common usage in everyday conversation.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦ばれる→ばれる：06721_bareru⟧ (to be found out, to be exposed) — the intransitive counterpart for sense 1. ばらす is the deliberate act of revealing; ⟦ばれる→ばれる：06721_bareru⟧ is when something becomes known.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ばらす (to reveal a secret)
- ⟦ネタ→ネタ：06309_neta⟧ばらし (spoiler — revealing the punchline or plot)
- ⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ばらす (to dismantle a machine)
